data.summary:
Software engineering professional with deep expertise in developing robust, scalable applications. Strong focus on team collaboration, driving projects to successful completion, and adapting to evolving requirements. Proficient in multiple programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Values delivering high- quality results and fostering productive work environment.
Experience - 6.1 yrs
Coforge | Senior Software Engineer
Aug 2024 – Present
Developed a Specialized Language Model (SLM) using GenAI and LangChain for cancer diagnostics, leveraging NLP and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques to enhance clinical decision support with accurate and context-rich outputs.
Created a machine learning classifier with anomaly detection for Mission Watch, optimizing aviation alert management through real-time filtering and prioritization.
Designed and delivered scalable, AI-powered applications by applying agile methodologies and modular GenAI components for rapid and efficient development cycles.
Managed multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strict deadlines and high-quality standards.
Ignitarium Technology Solutions | Senior Developer
Mar 2022 – Aug 2024
Led development of a rolling stock inspection system using image processing, Faster R-CNN, and UNet models in TensorFlow, achieving 86.3% average precision through hyperparameter tuning and cross- validation for accurate component detection and defect identification.
Managed Agile teams across multiple sprints, coordinated peer reviews, and ensured high-quality deliverables through continuous integration and iterative releases, demonstrating strong project management and collaboration skills.
Engineered a drone-based warehouse monitoring system, applying camera calibration, homography, and perspective transformation to align and decode barcodes, ensuring accurate shelf -level inventory updates.
Enhanced warehouse efficiency by integrating computer vision pipelines with real-time databases using Python, OpenCV, and image processing techniques, significantly improving data accuracy and system responsiveness.
Tata Consultancy Services | Associate Software Engineer
May 2019 – Mar 2022
Developed and executed strategic project plans aligned with business objectives, ensuring effective resource allocation and on-time delivery through strong planning and stakeholder collaboration.
Engineered deep learning modules for component detection using Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, NumPy, and Pandas, delivering robust image analysis and defect detection capabilities.
Applied advanced image processing techniques (rectification, enhancement, normalization) and implemented Faster R-CNN and UNet models in TensorFlow, achieving high detection accuracy through model tuning.
Led Agile development across multiple sprints, managing cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and progress tracking, while ensuring timely releases and maintaining high code quality and team coordination.
